mods.name: Better Collection
mods.author: Ben
mods.summary: Makes the gambit collection screen run smoothly.
mods.description:
The collection screen was drawing every card, button and arrow over itself up to 1250 times to fake a thick outline - the page arrows alone rebuilt as 7,500 shapes each, every time anything moved. This draws them twice instead: same look, a fraction of the cost. The run-info screen you open mid-run is built from the same pieces and gets the same treatment.

Prefer the chunkier outlines? Type 'collection outlines 4' in the console (F10) to put them back.

mods.description: A rare utility gambit that hooks the game's coin-spent event: whenever your money goes down (including strains), you immediately earn $1 back, complete with the floating money animation. Needs the Gambit Creation API, which installs automatically.

mods.name: Crybaby's Gambit
mods.author: Agent15
mods.summary: Every turn, each of your threatened pieces also counts as a capture, firing capture-triggered effects.
mods.description: On each player turn, right after threats are marked, every one of your pieces under threat fires the game's capture event as if it had been captured - the piece stays on the board, but anything that triggers on captures goes off. The author notes a known issue: starting a second game in the same session can leave your pieces unresponsive. Needs the Gambit Creation API, which installs automatically.

mods.name: Domino Effect's Gambit
mods.author: Agent15
mods.summary: When an enemy piece is trapped, trap every enemy piece adjacent to it.
mods.description: Trapping an enemy piece chains outward: every untrapped adjacent black piece gets trapped too, and each of those re-fires the trigger, so a well-placed trap can cascade across a cluster. Hooks both the hunter-tile and piece trap events. Epic rarity, priced at 8. Needs the Gambit Creation API, which installs automatically.

mods.name: Fall Guy
mods.author: Ben
mods.summary: Pieces about to fall are saved to the nearest free square, or the stash.
mods.description:
An Epic gambit for 8 coins. When the crumble takes a tile out from under one of your pieces, the piece does not die: it hops to the nearest intact empty square. If the whole board is out of squares it is dropped into your stash instead, ready to be placed again. Only when the stash is full too does the fall play out as vanilla wrote it.

Every fall is covered - there is no per-game limit. The buy-back graveyard is kept honest: a saved piece's booking is rolled back so a rescue is never also a free graveyard copy.

mods.name: Impatient Gambit
mods.author: Ben
mods.summary: Skip every stage straight to its boss, and earn 4x gold.
mods.description:
A Legendary gambit for 10 coins. Buy it and the next game is your current stage's boss; every stage after that goes straight to its own boss too, so a run collapses from 25 games to 5. All gold earned is multiplied by 4 to keep that survivable - five payouts instead of twenty-five - and the win screen gains a fourth breakdown row showing the bonus.

The run's opening game is never skipped: vanilla never treats it as a boss fight either.
